name: work
description: work — get a project's work done across the fleet, any kind, not just code. `/work:dispatch` takes ONE unit of work (a ticket, a described task, or 'the next thing on <project>'), finds/pulls the ticket while deduping against in-flight PRs and live sessions, classifies it as coding vs non-coding, files it clean if missing, then self-refers to the plugin that owns the execution — the `code` plugin for engineering, or `design`/`share` plus the `browser` skill and `secrets` for non-coding work (outreach, research, a design asset, a real web/portal task). Single-target dispatch, not a board sweep — deciding the whole board (keep/cancel/reprioritize) and surfacing calls that need the human is `/triage`'s job. The kind-agnostic superset of `/dispatch`.
